report_first_pages_follow_up.classification: Structural report/form recognition without automatic name catalogs. Independent report-start checks cover every CT_report page.
report_first_pages_follow_up.report_footer_rules: Mandatory footer/approved-name gate and numbering disqualification explicitly superseded. CFS 6.7/DCFS 4216 remain supporting clues, never approved names.
report_first_pages_follow_up.ranges: Every detected report start ends the preceding range, even unnamed. No one-page report-gap filling. Only accepted names create standalone work.
report_first_pages_follow_up.legacy_policy: Known complete public resources adapt read-only; unknown custom prose and immutable historical files remain literal. Explicit editing adds the fourth task without splitting old text.
report_first_pages_follow_up.authorization: User approved extra per-report-page checking cost and consistent report/form naming.
